before-100-hosidius-favour-if-the-player.npc: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have [number] buckets here, and [number] more in the bank. We require [number] buckets.
Do you wish to donate your fertiliser? We'll take what we need directly from your bank.

steps.text: All sulphurous fertilizer is taken from your inventory and bank.

before-100-hosidius-favour-if-the-player.npc: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. We currently require [number] buckets. Do come back if you every get any you'd be willing to donate.

with-100-hosidius-favour.npc: If you were planning to bring any fertiliser for the stores, please try again later. The stores are very full at present.

with-100-hosidius-favour.player: That's alright, I haven't brought any.
